dimensions.reason: The retention proposition and C-1 preserve record as stored notice plus receipt timestamp, with a same-corpus definition relation.

There is no guidance for independently observing preservation of limiting language or exception treatment.

Relevant definition, public-service scope, retention exception and timing context are followed within the pinned corpus; this does not cure the erroneous reverse exception relation.
The in-person appointment/attendance duty retains its organizer-register qualifier, NON_ASSESSABLE classification and grounded reason; no technical rule or fabricated evidence is added.
